digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler CLI and bridge exit code translation
propositions: Canonical preview/sync routes must emit only exit codes 0 (benign/success), 1 (operational failure), and 2 (invalid invocation), while legacy reconcile CLI routes must retain historical exits 3 (another pass), 4 (phase gate), and 75 (reschedule)
A single typed disposition enum must be consumed by both canonical and legacy adapters, with separate canonical and legacy exit mappings at the outer translator boundary
Legacy workflows, systemd units, Jenkins jobs, and checked-out scripts consuming exits 3/4/75 must continue to work without modification
The production workflow at .github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml must use only canonical 0/1/2 with no old-code numeric whitelist, while preserving paused commit-skip behavior
Documentation must publish both canonical and legacy exit-code contracts, rolling-migration rationale, and production/compatibility routing boundaries
